summary: Aeries Technology, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a one-for-eight reverse share consolidation approved by its board, effective June 12, 2026, to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The consolidation will reduce outstanding Class A ordinary shares from ~45.9M to ~5.7M, with fractional shares rounded up. No transaction, acquisition, or tender is involved; this is a routine corporate action to maintain listing, not a special situation.
